name: Sparkle
description:
A member of the Masked Fools. Inscrutable and unscrupulous.
A dangerous maestro of theatrics, utterly engrossed in the art of performance. Adorned with innumerable masks, she is the hero with a thousand faces.
Wealth, status, power... None of those matters to Sparkle. The only thing that can get her attention is "amusement."

skills.name: Monodrama
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Sparkle's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Dreamdiver
skills.desc:
Increases the CRIT DMG of a single target ally by #1[f1]% of Sparkle's CRIT DMG plus #2[f1]%, lasting for #3[i] turn(s). And at the same time, Advances Forward this ally's action by #4[i]%.
When Sparkle uses this ability on herself, the Action Advance effect will not trigger.
skills.simpleDesc: Increases an ally's CRIT DMG and Advances Forward their action.
